turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: How can I help you today?

turns.text: Hi, um I'm here because I've had this awful sore throat for the past four days. Doesn't seem to be getting any better and I think I'm developing a fever now.

turns.text: Have you checked your temperature?

turns.text: No, I haven't checked my temperature, I'm just really hot.

turns.text: We'll check that here then. And, uh, do you, OK so you've had this sore throat for four days and a fever. Have you had any difficulty swallowing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, um not, like I can drink OK, but it's really hard for me to eat solid foods right now.

turns.text: Um why is that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Oh it just hurts.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah, OK, but it's not that you can't um, you can't sort of like, you don't feel like it's getting stuck?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, no, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Um and have you noticed any changes in your voice? Do you find that your voice is more hoarse?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um a little bit uh but I think that's just because I try not to talk as much since my throat is so sore.

turns.text: OK, OK and uh have you had a runny nose?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No, OK. Um so all you have is a sore throat and this fever, OK um and um, OK. You have a headache?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um no headaches.

turns.text: Do you feel like you've been confused or just feeling not yourself?

turns.label: Patient

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Weight loss? Unintentional.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No weight loss, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Uh and uh do you have any medical conditions?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm no, I don't think so.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, are you up to date with your immunizations?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh yeah the only one that I haven't gotten is um that HPV vaccine.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK OK, um OK, any uh, did you get the flu shot?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Oh, I didn't get that this year.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, well we recommend that you you get your vaccines and um also the uh HPV vaccine. Um it's it's best to get the HPV vaccine earlier on. It's a little bit less effective as you um go past a certain age, you are still obviously nowhere close to that, but it's,  I I don't believe it's covered after the age of 26 either, so it's best if you get it done earlier. turns.text: Uhm, I got my appendix removed when I was 13.

turns.text: Anything else?

turns.text: No.

turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician

turns.text: Yeah, sure, OK. Um and uhm, I suppose just um OK. What was I gonna ask? Um do you uh, so no travels, OK. Do you feel like you've been in contact with someone who might be sick or might have Covid?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh I don't think so.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No, OK alright. And have you looked at your throat? Does it look swollen or red?

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Well, that's all the questions, oh one more question actually. Do you have um any medical conditions that run in the family?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um no, I don't think so. Maybe like high blood pressure.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Uh all right, well um that's all the questions I had. We'll do a physical exam, have a look inside your throat. Um given uh the symptoms that you have, it sounds like you have um an an inflammation or swelling of your throat which could be caused by bacteria or viruses. It could be something like um mono, or it could be um strep throat. Um it could be other things as well. Um seeing that your symptoms are somewhat overlapping with the symptoms for covid, we would also like to do a Covid test. Um we'll do a rapid strep test here as well um just to rule it out and then uh we'll uh ask you to quarantine for the next 14 days um until or at least until your covid swabs are back or your symptoms improve um and we'll let you know about um the management based on the strep test result. Do you have any questions?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um no, that sounds great, thank you.
